create_stereo_correspondences_loss: create a StereoCorrespondencesLoss module with configurable temperature, reduction, and max_pixels parameters
compute_similarities_between_descriptors: compute cosine or euclidean similarities between two sets of feature descriptors using get_similarities
compute_infoNCE_loss: compute dual softmax infoNCE loss for stereo image correspondence learning with tempered cosine similarities
sample_pixel_correspondences: sample and limit pixel correspondences to max_pixels for memory-efficient stereo correspondence loss computation
review_StereoCorrespondencesLoss_forward: review the StereoCorrespondencesLoss forward pass that computes infoNCE loss over batched stereo descriptor pairs
